_comment: App-owned acronym glossary (our quality layer — NOT OSO map data). Used to CORRECT wrong acronym expansions a model can invent: a known acronym renders with its real expansion, an unknown/ambiguous one (e.g. vLLM, whose expansion is unofficial) is stripped to the bare name. Only high-confidence expansions belong here — when unsure, omit (the default strip is the safe fallback). Keys are canonical casing; lookup is case-insensitive.
